publicWebsiteBoundaryNote: sos-public/ is the clean public Kelly Grappe for Arkansas Secretary of State website shell. Current content is placeholder and may be fully redesigned or replaced. The app boundary must stay clean: no RedDirt imports, no Prisma, no /admin routes, no voter-file tooling, no ingest pipelines, and no backend campaign OS coupling unless Steve explicitly approves an integration packet. RedDirt remains the campaign operating system / organizer engine—it may inform content, strategy, media, events, and structured recommendations for the public site, but RedDirt must not be merged into the public website.
